novelty.justification: The novelty route is a measurement framework: the claim asks whether “editing the internal variable that the law says is causal produce[s] the law-predicted counterfactual change in output” and aggregates direction, monotonicity, and quantitative calibration into a “Mechanism Fidelity Score.” Searches around “scientific foundation model causal intervention probing,” “activation steering physical laws,” “protein language model causal activation patching,” and “quantitative law activation intervention” identify the closest work as Physics Steering (2025), which intervenes on physical-concept directions to control predictions, and Mechanistic evidence that motif-gated domain recognition drives contact prediction in protein language models (2025), which uses causal patching to establish biological circuits. Moving from those studies to testing many established laws across scientific models is a natural but non-trivial extension: law-level effect-size calibration, matched non-causal correlates, and a cross-mechanism fidelity measure provide a substantive new operationalization, but causal representation editing itself is standard rather than a new core intervention paradigm.
